title: Abbas e Naujawanam
body:
Abbas e Naujawanam
Haay..
Jab hue bazu-e-abbas qalam, darya parr..
Girke thanda hua hazrat ka alam, darya parr..
Gharke khoo hogaya wo behre karam, darya parr..
Girte hi ghode se aaqa ko pukara rokar
Shaah khaime se chale, tha yahi nauha lab par
